title: Lab C: Audit & Shadow AI
description: Everything so far went through the gateway, but developers run MCP servers locally, never touching Obot — the shadow-AI blind spot. Enroll Obot Sentry, inventory your machine, forward local MCP logs to Obot, and enforce an allow-list so only approved local MCP servers can run.

From Visibility to Control — Local Enforcement
